verdict.rationale: Notion documents a public REST API that can "read, create, and update nearly everything in a workspace". It supports personal access tokens, internal static tokens and OAuth for public connections, and offers webhooks and Agent APIs. Probes confirm an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt are live, which suits AI-native consumption. missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of using the API in practice, and documentation of rate limits or coverage gaps ("nearly everything" implies some surfaces are not exposed).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: With the REST API, you can read, create, and update nearly everything in a workspace — pages, databases, users, comments, and more.
Personal access tokens (PATs) are user-scoped tokens for scripts, CLI workflows, Workers, and tools that should act as one Notion user.
create a personal access token, make your first API request, and see a new page appear in your workspace in under two minutes
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://developers.notion.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
Use sessions to start a chat, stream the Agent's reply, submit an action when needed, and read its event history.
